headline: MORE HOMES FOR NORTHWEST AUSTIN
caption:
Northwest Austin’s housing pipeline is getting a new mix of detached homes and townhomes.

Tri Pointe Homes has acquired 85.6 acres at Pearson Ranch and plans an estimated 410 homesites across multiple phases, according to an October 7 report from Builder & Developer.

The proposed mix includes single-family homes on several lot widths and attached row townhomes. Land development is expected to start in early 2027, with sales expected in 2028.

Why it matters locally: The plan would add more for-sale housing choices in Northwest Austin over time. This is a future supply story: the homes are planned, and the projected sales date is not a completion guarantee.

Prices were not specified in the report, so the announcement alone does not establish affordability.

Source: Builder & Developer, October 7, 2026
